hypotheses_evaluation.hypothesis: H1: MediaData internal property collision (__x_id, id, parent, collection) in whatsapp-web.js Utils.js spreads into outgoing message, crashing WhatsApp Web getter memoization.
hypotheses_evaluation.experiment: scripts/media-isolation.js ran matrix comparing unpatched vs patched spread. Every unpatched media case crashed with 'Data passed to getter must include an id property...'. Every patched case passed cleanly.

hypotheses_evaluation.hypothesis: H2: Recipient is a @lid stored as a phone number causing the crash.
hypotheses_evaluation.experiment: In S2 matrix, both @lid and @c.us experienced the exact same getter crash on the original media path. However, bidirectional LID resolution is retained for delivery reliability.

hypotheses_evaluation.hypothesis: H3: Undefined/null keys leaking in options object.
hypotheses_evaluation.experiment: Dirty options containing undefined/null keys caused additional instability; stripping clean options is verified in test 7b.

hypotheses_evaluation.hypothesis: H4: Media file empty or bad source URL.
hypotheses_evaluation.experiment: Asset 1 exists on disk, size 3354244 bytes with valid %PDF header. Addressed permanently via S5 DB-backed storage.
